Task description: Place the two brown shoe models with ribbed soles from the left and right sides of the table into the orange rectangular Nike shoebox at the bottom of the image, arranging them as a pair in the specified positions and orientations.

Success criteria: The shoe on the left in the current image is near the center-front of the box (lower in the image), and the right shoe is near the center-back (upper in the image), arranged side by side front to back. Both lie flat near the box bottom, soles down and uppers up, with toes pointing left in the image; both grippers are open and have released the shoes.

## Execution tips

- Approach the shoe middle from above and grasp continuous side panels above the sole across its width, avoiding laces and the thin opening edge. Open slightly wider than that section and confirm the fingers straddle the shoe before closing.
- When turning the shoe toe, leave clearance between the sole and table or box rim, and allow space for both the toe and heel to swing. Avoid hitting the large cup behind the box or the other shoe.
- During descent into the box, watch clearance around the toe, heel, and gripper relative to the rim. If one shoe is already inside, adjust lateral position slightly to avoid pushing or tilting it with the other.
- Before releasing, ensure the shoe sole is securely supported to avoid turning it over while suspended. After opening the gripper, withdraw upward to reduce catching the shoe opening or moving a shoe already placed.
